验收标记 R04-BEGIN

# 校园太阳能学习角｜R04 交互实验

本轮延续方案B的设计参数，将能源估算与概念测验组合成两个独立的交互模块。第一个模块允许调整太阳能板额定功率、每日等效日照小时数与系统综合效率，实时计算预计日发电量，并与当前480 Wh的每日计划负载比较。第二个模块通过三道选择题检查对瓦特、瓦时和千瓦时的理解。两个模块分别负责数值探索和知识验证，计算使用理想化假设，不代表真实校园环境的实测结果。

## ① 每日太阳能发电量计算器

{@body const [power,setPower] = DIL.useState(400)}
{@body const [sun,setSun] = DIL.useState(5)}
{@body const [eff,setEff] = DIL.useState(80)}
{@body const daily = power*sun*eff/100/1000}
{@body const load = 0.48}
<box border radius="xl" padding={3} gap={3}>
  <row justify="between" align="center">
    <text weight="medium">光伏发电模拟</text>
    <button color="secondary" variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={()=>{setPower(400);setSun(5);setEff(80)}}><icon name="rotate-ccw" size="xs"/> 重置</button>
  </row>
  <box background="surface-secondary" radius="lg" padding={3} gap={1}>
    <text color="secondary" size="xs">预计每日发电量</text>
    <row align="baseline" gap={1}>
      <title size="2xl" color="default" tabularNums>{daily.toFixed(2)}</title>
      <text weight="medium">kWh/日</text>
    </row>
    <text color="secondary" size="xs">计算公式：功率 × 等效日照 × 效率 ÷ 1000</text>
  </box>
  <box gap={1}>
    <row align="center" justify="between">
      **太阳能板功率**
      <text tabularNums weight="medium">{power} W</text>
    </row>
    <slider min={100} max={1000} step={50} value={power} onChange={setPower}/>
    <row justify="between">
      <caption>100 W</caption>
      <caption>1000 W</caption>
    </row>
  </box>
  <box gap={1}>
    <row align="center" justify="between">
      **每日等效日照**
      <text tabularNums weight="medium">{sun.toFixed(1)} 小时</text>
    </row>
    <slider min={0} max={10} step={0.5} value={sun} onChange={setSun}/>
    <row justify="between">
      <caption>0 小时</caption>
      <caption>10 小时</caption>
    </row>
  </box>
  <box gap={1}>
    <row align="center" justify="between">
      **系统综合效率**
      <text tabularNums weight="medium">{eff}%</text>
    </row>
    <slider min={40} max={100} step={5} value={eff} onChange={setEff}/>
    <row justify="between">
      <caption>40%</caption>
      <caption>100%</caption>
    </row>
  </box>
  <divider color="subtle"/>
  <grid columns={2} gap={2}>
    <grid-item>
      <box gap={1}>
        <text size="xs" color="secondary">每日计划负载</text>
        <title size="lg" tabularNums>0.48 kWh</title>
      </box>
    </grid-item>
    <grid-item>
      <box gap={1}>
        <text size="xs" color="secondary">预计每日净余量</text>
        <title size="lg" color={daily>=load?"success":"danger"} tabularNums>{daily>=load?"+":""}{(daily-load).toFixed(2)} kWh</title>
      </box>
    </grid-item>
  </grid>
  <box gap={1}>
    <row height="12px" radius="full" background="surface-tertiary" clip gap={0}>
      <box background={daily>=load?"#188A80":"#D98943"} width={`${daily>0?Math.min(100,load/daily*100):100}%`}/>
      <box background="#A4C8B0" flex="1"/>
    </row>
    <caption>{daily===0?"当前无发电量，需由电池或其他电源供电。":daily>=load?"预计发电量可覆盖每日计划负载。":"预计发电量不足，需由储能补足缺口。"}</caption>
  </box>
</box>

两个卡片之间的解释：计算器用于估算，测验用于理解，二者不能互相替代。

<divider spacing={4}/>

## ② 能量单位小测验

{@body const quiz = [{q:"太阳能板标注的 400 W 表示什么？",opts:["额定功率","每日发电量","电池储能容量"],correct:0,why:"W（瓦特）是功率单位，表示能量转换的速率，而不是累计能量。"},{q:"1 kWh 等于多少 Wh？",opts:["100 Wh","1000 Wh","3600 Wh"],correct:1,why:"1 kWh = 1000 Wh；而 1 Wh = 3600 J，两种转换不能混淆。"},{q:"一台 60 W 展示屏运行 4 小时，消耗多少电能？",opts:["15 Wh","60 Wh","240 Wh"],correct:2,why:"能量 = 功率 × 时间 = 60 W × 4 h = 240 Wh，即 0.24 kWh。"}]}
{@body const [answers,setAnswers] = DIL.useState({})}
{@body const count = Object.keys(answers).length}
{@body const score = quiz.filter((q,i)=>answers[i]===q.correct).length}
<box border radius="xl" padding={3} gap={3}>
  <row justify="between" align="center">
    <text color="secondary" size="sm">已回答 {count}/3 道</text>
    <button size="sm" variant="outline" color="secondary" onClick={()=>setAnswers({})}><icon name="rotate-ccw" size="xs"/> 重新测验</button>
  </row>
  <box background="surface-tertiary" radius="full" height="6px" clip>
    <box background="rgba(57,151,130,0.85)" height="100%" width={`${count/3*100}%`} radius="full"/>
  </box>
  {#each quiz as q,i}
    <box key={i} gap={2}>
      <text weight="medium">{i+1}. {q.q}</text>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={answers[i]===undefined?"":String(answers[i])} onChange={v=>setAnswers(a=>({...a,[i]:Number(v)}))}>
        {#each q.opts as opt,j}
          <radio value={String(j)}>{opt}</radio>
        {/each}
      </radio-group>
      {#if answers[i]!==undefined}
        <row align="start" gap={2}>
          <icon name={answers[i]===q.correct?"check-circle":"alert-circle"} color={answers[i]===q.correct?"success":"danger"}/>
          <box flex="1" gap={1}>
            <text weight="medium" color={answers[i]===q.correct?"success":"danger"}>{answers[i]===q.correct?"回答正确":"回答错误"}</text>
            <text size="sm">{q.why}</text>
          </box>
        </row>
      {/if}
    </box>
    {#if i<2}
      <divider color="subtle"/>
    {/if}
  {/each}
  {#if count===3}
    <box background="surface-secondary" radius="lg" padding={3} align="center" gap={1}>
      <title size="xl" tabularNums>{score}/3</title>
      <text weight="medium">{score===3?"全部答对！":score===2?"掌握了大部分概念":"建议复习功率与能量的关系"}</text>
    </box>
  {/if}
</box>

## 本轮结论

计算器默认输出为 **1.60 kWh/日**，对应R02中验证过的理论日发电量；每日计划负载为0.48 kWh，理论净余量1.12 kWh。通过调整参数，可以观察环境与设备性能如何影响供需平衡。测验则验证是否能正确区分功率和能量。两个模块相互独立，不共享操作状态，适合分别导出、保存和恢复。

验收标记 R04-END
